name: Federal Realty Investment Trust

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Federal Realty Investment Trust logo.svg)

description: Federal Realty owns and redevelops high-quality retail and mixed-use properties, mostly in major coastal markets: 104 predominantly retail projects with about 28.8 million commercial sq ft at 2025-12-31 (103 at 2026-06-30), including destination mixed-use districts such as Santana Row (San Jose), Assembly Row (Somerville), and Bethesda Row. Money is rent from about 3,700 commercial leases (retailers pay base rent plus recovery of costs) and about 2,700 residential leases (apartments in the mixed-use projects). Revenue was $1,279.0M in 2025 (+6 percent). It has raised its regular annual dividend for 58 consecutive years. Its centers are 96.1 percent leased and 93.8 percent occupied at 2026-06-30.

gics.note: Sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies'; industry group and industry not given there.

hq.note: 909 Rose Avenue, Suite 200 (SEC EDGAR business address); Wikipedia's list shows Rockville, Maryland

businessLines.name: Retail and mixed-use real estate (commercial and residential rent)
businessLines.how: Retail tenants pay monthly minimum rent under multi-year leases plus reimbursement of operating costs and taxes and percentage rent; residential tenants pay monthly apartment rent; growth comes from rent increases on new and renewed leases, higher occupancy and redeveloping its sites into denser mixed-use.
businessLines.description: 104 predominantly retail projects (about 28.8M commercial sq ft) at 2025-12-31, mixed-use with residential and office components at places like Santana Row, Assembly Row and Bethesda Row. The 10-K text read reports one rental business and does not give a separate revenue split for commercial versus residential.

revenue.note: Rental income $1,245.5M (FY2024 $1,170.1M); other property income $32.4M; mortgage interest income $1.1M; FY2024 total $1,202.5M. Six months to 2026-06-30 total property revenue $676.8M (+9.0%); Q2 2026 $335.7M (+7.8%).
